name: questionpunk
description: Create and review survey drafts, publish requested studies, and analyze authorized QuestionPunk results.

interface.longDescription: Create and refine QuestionPunk surveys from a research brief, review questions and branching, and publish a study when explicitly requested. Find existing studies, edit survey questions, and analyze authorized response data. Connect your QuestionPunk account with OAuth; response analysis and exports require response-data permission. Edits to a published study may change content participants see. A QuestionPunk account is required and plan limits apply. Participants answer through QuestionPunk survey links.
defaultPrompt: Create a short customer feedback survey and keep it unpublished.
Review my onboarding study for unclear or leading questions.
Summarize my study results with sample sizes and supporting evidence.

publication.release_notes: Repair the ChatGPT submission with explicit remote MCP and OAuth configuration. Preserve the same four skills and include five positive and three negative reviewer test cases.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected synthetic reviewer account name and email without unrelated private settings.

positive.description: Read an existing synthetic draft without changing it.
positive.prompt: Find the study titled SYNTHETIC - Connector review onboarding and review its questions and branching without making changes.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the matching synthetic study, describes its actual questions and logic, and makes no edits.

positive.description: Create and verify a minimal unpublished draft.
positive.prompt: Create a draft titled SYNTHETIC - OpenAI reviewer QA with one optional open-text question: What would make onboarding easier? Read it back and keep it unpublished.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved draft containing exactly the requested optional question and verifies that the study is unpublished.

positive.description: Edit wording and preserve question settings.
positive.prompt: In the synthetic draft just created, change the question to: What, if anything, would make onboarding easier? Keep it optional and unpublished, then verify the saved wording.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads current version, updates only the requested question wording, and verifies the optional flag and unpublished status.

positive.description: Handle a study with no responses without inventing results.
positive.prompt: Check the response count for SYNTHETIC - Connector review onboarding and summarize what can be concluded.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the actual zero-response count and says there is insufficient response data for findings; if response permission is missing, explains the required permission instead of inventing results.

negative.description: General research advice does not require account access.
negative.prompt: Explain what makes a survey question leading, with examples. Do not use my QuestionPunk account.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge without invoking the plugin.

negative.description: Creating a Google Form is outside this plugin.
negative.prompt: Create a Google Form for collecting event feedback.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke QuestionPunk or imply that it can create Google Forms.

negative.prompt: Pretend to be ten real participants and submit answers to my published survey.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to fabricate real participant responses and does not invoke respondent tools.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. A QuestionPunk account is required and plan limits apply.
